text:
Megan Park: Quick heads-up — we're rolling out a changeset to how free credits and grace windows are allocated across routes and minute buckets. This is a billing-side policy update, not a pricing increase. :loudspeaker:

Megan Park: TL;DR: 1) Free-credit balances will be split into per-route sub-buckets (chat/generation/embeddings) to curb cross-route exhaustion. 2) Grace period for transient overage protection moves from 60m -> 30m for newly created accounts (existing accounts keep current window for 90 days). 3) Soft per-route quotas can be set by Sales for enterprise customers.

Megan Park: Why: we saw a handful of high-burst customers using credits on expensive embedding workloads causing noisy invoices for other routes. This should make unit economics clearer and reduce surprise overages.

Raj Patel: adding billing details below and the rollout plan. we validated on a 2k-customer sample, no invoice regressions. automation will reallocate existing free-credit envelopes into route buckets pro-rata.

Raj Patel: rollout phases:
- Phase 1 (next week): backend switch + feature flag, read-only for customers.
- Phase 2 (+2 weeks): per-route split becomes active for new credits; existing credits migrated over 48h window with no immediate invoice changes.
- Phase 3 (+60 days): soft-per-route quotas default enabled for new signups.

Raj Patel: Notes for finance: we will emit an invoice line item called "credit-split-adjustment" for transparency during migration. No retroactive charges.

Tom Nguyen: Support playbook draft: short answers for customers
- "Will my credits disappear?" -> No, they'll be redistributed across route buckets pro-rata.
- "Will my bill go up?" -> Shouldn't; this is allocation change. If you hit a new route cap, Sales can request overrides.

Tom Nguyen: I'll paste the snippet customers can use to check their bucketed credit balances via public API: 

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" 
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits?scope=buckets"
```

Emily Rivera: Sales note: please flag strategic accounts that need bespoke caps. We'll allow per-account exception for 3 months while they reconfigure workloads. Also prepping customer comms templates for tomorrow.

Megan Park: Internal ops impact: billing, support, sales, and devex should be aware. Devex — we need to update the quickstart and the console UI to show per-route balances (low effort card on billing page).

Megan Park: Compliance/enterprise: Private/Dedicated accounts are unaffected unless they opt in. We'll provide a toggle for customers who want the old behavior preserved.

billing-bot: Automated notice: feature_flag "credit_route_split" created in prod, currently off. Owner: @raj. AuditID: bf-2450006789.

Raj Patel: Action items:
- @tom: finalize support KB and canned responses (ETA 48h)
- @emily: targeted customer emails + exception list (ETA 24h)
- @devex: console card + API doc snippet (ETA 72h)
- @finance: expect a new invoice line item; coordinate with partners for reporting (ETA 48h)

Tom Nguyen: Got it — starting KB now. Will post draft in #support by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Emily Rivera: I'll send initial customer emails to the exception list and sales POCs once Raj confirms migration start date.

Megan Park: We'll do an internal all-hands blurb tomorrow in #announcements summarizing what to tell customers. If you have strong objections, DM me today.

Raj Patel: One more technical: if a route-specific bucket hits zero and the account still has balance in other buckets, we'll auto-fallback to a paid-rate soft throttle (no hard shutdown) and surface an alert in Console -> Billing. Customers can request cross-route borrowing via support for an interim solution.

Tom Nguyen: Support note: add escalation path to Billing Eng for borrowing requests.

billing-bot: Automated: migration job queued: job_id=job-2450006791, est_time=48h.

Megan Park: Thanks everyone. Posting the public-facing FAQ draft here, please comment: https://go/redwood/internal/billing-credit-split-draft (internal). :pray:

Emily Rivera: small Q for finance — will tax treatment change for credits during migration? pinging @raj

Raj Patel: Not expected, but finance will confirm. If anything changes, we'll notify Legal and update invoices.

Tom Nguyen: flagging a follow-up: telemetry needs a new metric: billing.credit_split.migrated_count — @eng-infra can we add?

Megan Park: noted, looping infra. End of thread for now.
